RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of bias; panels are typically determined by relevant executive and HR roles. Furthermore, the appointed candidate had distinct, relevant strengths—specifically digital media expertise, which is often a strategic priority over sheer length of service. 

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of discrimination (such as inappropriate interview remarks or procedural irregularities) is likely to be viewed as ungrounded and could damage your professional reputation. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on the decision. Focus on identifying which skills or interview areas you can develop for future leadership opportunities.
